basic_info.description: Located on a quiet, tree-lined street in Presidio Heights, this inviting five-bedroom home is filled with light and includes abundant spaces for effortless living and entertaining. The main level begins with a living room with sunny bay windows and a fireplace; further back are a formal dining room and a discreet powder room; and along the southern side of the home are a charming family room and a spacious cook's kitchen with an island, a walk-in pantry, a wet bar, a bright breakfast room, and sliding glass doors to a terrace with stairs leading to the large garden below. Secluded on the uppermost level are four bedrooms including the principal suite that basks in light from a wide bay window and is accompanied by a walk-in closet and a spa-like bath with a shower, a contemporary soaking tub, and a dual vanity. There are three additional bedrooms and two baths on this level, including a bedroom suite with southern views of Sutro Tower and a built-in window bench. The garden level offers a comfortable guest bedroom, full bath and a cheerful family room with built-ins and glass doors affording direct access to the idyllic backyard terrace and garden. Ideally located near the restaurants and shops of Sacramento St and Laurel Village, and the Presidio.
